test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 15 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the full form of BHIM?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharat Interface for Money**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharat Interface for Money (BHIM)** is a mobile payment app developed by the **National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI)**, based on the Unified Payments Interface (UPI).
 
• BHIM was launched on **30th December 2016** by Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** to facilitate e-payments directly through banks and encourage cashless transactions.
 
• The app supports multiple Indian languages and is designed to be simple and user-friendly to ensure financial inclusion.
 
• Users can make instant bank-to-bank payments and collect money using their **Mobile number or Payment address**.
 
• BHIM is interoperable with other UPI applications and bank accounts across India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Unified Payments Interface (UPI)** is a real-time payment system that allows instant transfer of funds between two bank accounts on a mobile platform.
 
• UPI eliminates the need to enter bank details or other sensitive information every time a transaction is made, ensuring a secure and seamless payment experience.
 
• BHIM app requires users to register their bank account with UPI and set a UPI PIN for the bank account.
 
• Transactions can be performed 24x7, including on public holidays.
 
• BHIM also supports **QR code-based payments** for easy and quick transactions.
